text.p: AT&T Corp. Chairman Robert Allen left the hospital Tuesday after undergoing surgery for a faulty heart valve last week.
Allen, 62, returned to his New Jersey home to convalesce after surgery in Rochester, Minn., on Thursday, a company spokeswoman said.
"He is looking forward to returning to work by the end of the month," the spokeswoman said.
In his absence Chief Operating Officer John Walter is running AT&T. Walter is formally slated to become chief executive in May 1998.
